title: Reason Code 4/5/6/261: NPS could not reach Active Directory
plain_english: NPS could not talk to a domain controller or the global catalog, so it could not authenticate or authorize anyone. Every user fails at once, and nothing about their credentials matters until the NPS server can see the domain again.

any: unable to access the Active Directory Domain Services
unable to connect to a domain controller
cannot contact Active Directory Domain Services

causes.cause: No domain controller or global catalog reachable from the NPS server: DNS, firewall, or the DCs are down.
causes.next_check: On the NPS server run nltest /dsgetdc:<domain> and nltest /sc_verify:<domain>; check DNS resolution of the domain's SRV records.

causes.cause: The NPS server's secure channel to the domain is broken.
causes.next_check: Test-ComputerSecureChannel -Repair -Credential <domain admin> on the NPS server, then restart the NPS service.

causes.cause: The NPS server is not registered in Active Directory, so it cannot read account dial-in properties.
causes.next_check: NPS console > right-click NPS (Local) > Register server in Active Directory; confirm the computer account is in the 'RAS and IAS Servers' group in every domain it serves.
